data.name: Galaxiwilds
data.detailed_description:
Galaxiwilds is a narrative-driven space exploration experience focused on discovery, first contact, and uncovering the unknown.

Reality is breaking.

Across multiple universes, rifts tear through space, black holes behave unpredictably, and entire systems collapse without warning. These phenomena are not random—they are connected.

Your mission is not to conquer.
It is to understand.

Travel between universes, chart strange systems, and make contact with 75 unique alien civilizations, each with their own culture, history, technology, and perspective on the unfolding crisis.

Some will share knowledge.
Some will grant you new abilities.
Some will offer allies you can call upon—individuals with their own personalities, insights, and stories to tell.

As your network grows, so does your understanding of what lies beyond the rifts… and what may be causing them.

But this is not a guided journey.

Clues are not handed to you. Coordinates are not saved. Information must be observed, remembered, and recorded.

The truth is out there—but only if you’re paying attention.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz x64
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 / OpenGL 3.2 capable
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1.2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound / CoreAudio compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated or modern integrated (Intel Iris Xe / AMD Vega+)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Stereo output

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 dual-core 2.0 GHz or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU (all Macs from 2012+)
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio compatible
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 / Intel Core i5 quad-core 2.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon GPU or Intel Iris Plus / AMD Radeon
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Stereo output

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / Debian 11 / Fedora 36 (glibc 2.31+)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz x64
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2 capable (Mesa 20+)
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: PulseAudio or PipeWire
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or later
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Mesa 22+ / NVIDIA proprietary driver
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Sound Card: PipeWire
